theorem actualFrozenCapacityFactors_correct {α : Type*} {A B : ℝ}
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (upper actual : α → ℕ) (input : List α)
    (hfull : actualDwellSupport (A * B) (input.map upper))

      ((actualFrozenCapacityFactors A upper actual input).2 : ℝ) ≤ B
